scope: Read-only source clarification of the reported child request fields. It does not establish actual peer policy, actual deployed controller revision, a runtime adapter fault or a new operational action.
source_chain: FederationStore._insert_child_mirror creates display mirror rows for children spawned on the peer, passing only job identity, peer-reported resources and parent-seeded priority to insert_mirrored_job_config.
insert_mirrored_job_config deliberately leaves entrypoint, bundle, retries, timeout and constraints at job_config schema defaults because the parent never authored or executes that child request.
Schema defaults are failure0, preemption100, timeoutNULL, constraintsNULL, entrypoint{} and empty bundle. Those values exactly match the reported suspicious pattern.

GetJobStatus reconstructs a LaunchJobRequest from the local row through reconstruct_launch_job_request. A NULL timeout is not populated, hence reads as proto0; absent constraints render[]. Workdir files are deliberately omitted from status even for normal jobs.
priority_limit: Mirrored child priority is explicitly a parent-seeded display value; the peer summary has no child override priority. Do not use mirrored priority alone as proof of the child's effective priority, whether it agrees with the expected value or not.
interpretation: The source establishes how a parent mirror can show0/100/timeout0/[] without the peer running with those settings. Thus that view alone is not evidence that A12's actual timeout/retry arguments were dropped. It also cannot certify the effective0/0/7200 policy. Offered native args remain separately proven; authoritative peer-side request provenance would be needed for actual policy confirmation.
